title: How Summer’s Biggest Moments Shaped Listening Trends on Spotify
summary: The post How Summer’s Biggest Moments Shaped Listening Trends on Spotify appeared first on Spotify .
body_markdown:
When something big happens in culture, the soundtrack mirrors the moment. This summer, as people celebrated history-making sporting events and obsessed over record-breaking world tours, a parallel story was playing out on Spotify, where fans were busy finding ways to channel their enthusiasm into listening habits.


Here’s how the season’s biggest headlines shaped how, and what, the world streamed this summer.


## Football was Everywhere


Even if you’re not a superfan, it was hard to not get swept up in the excitement surrounding the biggest football tournament in the world. On Spotify, that enthusiasm swelled to become the[sound of summer](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2026-07-20/world-soccer-tournament-music-streaming-data/) . Country anthem streams spiked during high-stakes matches.[Shakira](https://open.spotify.com/artist/0EmeFodog0BfCgMzAIvKQp) cemented her status as the[(unofficial) queen of football](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2026-07-07/shakira-global-football/) , and a first-of-its-kind halftime show took things to another level. Here’s how fans celebrated with their favorite artists, tracks, and teams.


## Latin music’s star continued to rise


Latin music’s global footprint is bigger than ever. Bad Bunny brought his high-energy tour to packed venues across Europe, causing his (


[already dazzling](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-12-03/wrapped-bad-bunny-top-artist-album/) ) streaming stats to soar. And while he’s one of the biggest names in the game, he’s also part of a much larger story.


Artists like


hitmaker


[Ryan Castro](https://open.spotify.com/artist/7j6DKwmjbxvpQO8h914uEz) , are growing beyond the region and finding new audiences around the world, while breakout tracks like “


[Dichavate](https://open.spotify.com/track/6Ab2trdJulkRRhaJ9zVGQa?si=424cf310ba134000) ” — a collaboration between


[Ya Ice Dilan](https://open.spotify.com/artist/3EumQuYai5g1235jIBaPhA) ,


[Rey Tony](https://open.spotify.com/artist/7o5F7ecSmTFTIt9lrDtB0l) ,


[Helabusador](https://open.spotify.com/artist/43FkTZ35A6B7miP8a5AlPX) ,


[JipMusic Global](https://open.spotify.com/artist/6qX4h29LUPPUx0ykEdYAL7) , and


[DJ Honda](https://open.spotify.com/artist/5OLgZmlrgCBKtR47DXwnsk) — became viral sensations, keeping the momentum going strong.


## NYC threw a summer party to remember


New York City always brings the noise, but this summer, the volume was turned up to 11. Between big sports moments and


[JAŸ-Z](https://open.spotify.com/artist/3nFkdlSjzX9mRTtwJOzDYB) ’s Yankee Stadium residency, listeners around the world wanted a piece of the Big Apple.


## Onscreen hits fueled audiobook streams


There’s nothing quite like watching a beloved book come to life.


This summer’s film adaptation of


[The Odyssey](https://open.spotify.com/show/3sI5TsJwGBySuKwF4pNCTD?si=9659b53f5e534995&nd=1&dlsi=d00feb9c7f93465d) took over the box office, while contemporary novel


[The Five-Star Weekend](https://open.spotify.com/show/4cwmViTcM1eUNWwlFxzXsF) was a hit on the small screen. Although a decade-long journey home and a dramatic weekend in Nantucket may be worlds apart, they do have one thing in common: both sent fans flocking to Spotify to rediscover where the stories began. And 25 years after the first film,


*Harry Potter* continues to enchant audiences both on screen and on the page. When the


[audiobook series arrived on Spotify](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2026-07-01/harry-potter-audiobook-launch/) this summer, the season became a little more magical.


## It was a BTS summer


We knew


[BTS](https://open.spotify.com/artist/3Nrfpe0tUJi4K4DXYWgMUX) would be the talk of the music world from the moment they announced their new album,


[ARIRANG](https://open.spotify.com/album/3ukkRHDHbN8tNRPKsGZR1h) . When it dropped this spring, it quickly became the most-streamed K-Pop album in Spotify history. But the real story is its staying power: As temperatures rose, ARMY played BTS’ tracks on repeat,


[breaking records](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2026-07-18/bts-music-video-normal/) along the way and keeping the global pop superstars firmly in the cultural conversation.


## Trending now: romance and cortisol


What else was hot this season? We dug into the data to see what listeners were streaming, playlisting, and which topics were popping up across in the podcast world in Summer 2026 vs the same timeframe last year. From shifts in fitness playlists to evolving audiobook trends, here’s a look at how this summer stacked up against the last.
